prose: OpenAI announces phased plans for text watermarking and provenance to meet the EU AI Act requirement that generated text be machine-identifiable, while saying watermarking and detection remain early technologies with significant limitations (via Daring Fireball). Basis: the feed excerpt quoting OpenAI's announcement; the full page was not read.
